requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to record and maintain my profile information including my contact details and an optional bank account, so that the system can identify me and associate me with my orders.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall store a name, an address and a phone number for each customer.
The system shall allow a customer to have at most one bank account, which is optional.
The system shall treat the customer name, address and phone number as mandatory attributes, and shall treat the bank account as optional.
Given a customer profile submission missing any mandatory attribute, When the customer attempts to save the profile, Then the system shall reject the customer record and register no customer.
Given valid customer details including name, address, phone number and an optional bank account, When the customer submits the profile, Then the system shall record the customer profile.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to browse products with their name, description, price and image, so that I can choose items to purchase.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall store a name, a description, a price and an image for each product.
The system shall allow a product to be referred to by any number of order items, including none, and shall keep a product in existence independently of the order items that refer to it.
The system shall treat name, description, price and image as mandatory attributes for every product, and shall reject a product record in which a mandatory attribute is absent.
The system shall represent product price as a decimal number.
Given products stored in the system, When a customer browses the product catalog, Then the system shall display the name, description, decimal price and image of each available product.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit an order containing one or more items and a selected payment method, so that I can purchase the selected products.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall record each order with an order date, a total amount, a status and a payment method.
The system shall record each order item with a quantity, a unit price and a reference to exactly one product, and shall associate each order item with exactly one order.

The system shall keep an order item in existence only as part of the order it belongs to, shall not allow an order item to be moved to another order, and shall remove the order items of an order when that order is removed.
The system shall associate each order with exactly one customer, while a customer may have any number of orders.

Given a known customer, one or more order items each referencing an existing product, and a valid payment method, When the customer submits the order, Then the system shall register it as an order with the submission date as its order date, the status submitted, and a total amount equal to the sum over its order items of quantity multiplied by unit price.
Given an order submission where the customer is not known to the system, When the customer submits the order, Then the system shall reject the order submission and register no order.
Given an order submission that contains no order item, When the customer submits the order, Then the system shall reject the order submission and register no order.
Given an order submission where any order item refers to a product that does not exist, When the customer submits the order, Then the system shall reject the order submission and register no order.
The system shall represent the unit price and order total amount as decimal numbers.
The system shall restrict the status of an order to submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.
The system shall restrict the payment method recorded on an order to bank, card or cash.

requirements.statement: As a OrderStaff, I want to receive a submitted order by transitioning its status to pending, so that our fulfillment team can begin processing it.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is submitted, When order staff receives the order, Then the system shall set the status of the order to pending.
Given an order whose status is not submitted, When order staff attempts to receive the order, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the order unchanged.
The system shall change the status of an order from submitted only to pending.

requirements.statement: As a OrderStaff, I want to mark a pending order as filled once items are assembled, so that the order is ready for invoicing and shipment.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is pending, When order staff marks the order as filled, Then the system shall set the status of the order to filled.
Given an order whose status is not pending, When order staff attempts to mark the order as filled, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the order unchanged.
The system shall change the status of an order from pending only to filled or to closed.

requirements.statement: As a OrderStaff, I want to decline a pending order by setting its status to closed, so that an unfulfillable order is terminated without raising an invoice.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is pending, When order staff declines the order, Then the system shall set the status of the order to closed.
Given an order whose status is not pending, When order staff attempts to decline the order, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the order unchanged.
Given an order that has been declined, When an accountant requests to raise an invoice for that order, Then the system shall reject the request.
The system shall not change the status of an order whose status is closed.

requirements.statement: As a OrderStaff, I want to set a filled order to shipped, so that goods can be dispatched to the customer independently of invoicing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is filled, When order staff sets the status of the order to shipped, Then the system shall set the status of the order to shipped.
Given an order whose status is not filled, When order staff attempts to set the order to shipped, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the order unchanged.
Given an order being set to shipped, When the status of the order changes to shipped, Then the system shall leave the status of an invoice and of any payment against that invoice unchanged.
The system shall let invoicing and shipping proceed independently of each other once an order has been filled, so that setting the order to shipped does not require an invoice to have been raised.
The system shall change the status of an order from filled only to shipped.

requirements.statement: As a Accountant, I want to raise an invoice for a filled or shipped order, so that the customer can be billed for their order.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall record each invoice with a date, an amount, a status and a payment method.
The system shall allow at most one invoice per order, and shall associate each invoice with exactly one order.

Given an order whose status is filled or shipped and that has no invoice, When an accountant raises an invoice for that order, Then the system shall record an invoice for the order with a date, an amount, a payment method and the status issued.
Given an order that already has an invoice, When an accountant requests to raise a further invoice for that order, Then the system shall reject the request.
Given an order whose status is submitted, pending or closed, When an accountant requests to raise an invoice for that order, Then the system shall reject the request.
The system shall let invoicing and shipping proceed independently of each other once an order has been filled, so that raising an invoice does not require the order to have been shipped.
The system shall represent the invoice amount as a decimal number.
The system shall restrict the status of an invoice to issued or paid.
The system shall restrict the payment method recorded on an invoice to bank, card or cash.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit a payment against an issued invoice, so that I can pay for my order using a supported payment method.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall record each payment with a date, an amount, a status and a payment method.
The system shall allow any number of payments against one invoice, and shall record each payment against exactly one invoice rather than directly against an order.

Given an invoice whose status is issued, When a customer submits a payment against that invoice with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system shall record the payment against that invoice with the status pending.
Given an invoice whose status is paid, When a customer submits a payment against that invoice, Then the system shall reject the payment.

Given an invoice whose earlier payment has the status failed, When a customer submits a further payment against that invoice, Then the system shall record it as a separate payment with the status pending, and shall keep the failed payment at the status failed.
The system shall represent the payment amount as a decimal number.
The system shall restrict the status of a payment to pending, completed or failed.
The system shall restrict the payment method recorded on a payment to bank, card or cash.

requirements.statement: As a Accountant, I want to confirm a pending payment, so that the received payment is marked completed and the associated invoice is marked paid.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is pending, When an accountant confirms the payment, Then the system shall set the status of that payment to completed.
Given an accountant confirms a pending payment against an invoice whose status is issued, When the confirmation occurs, Then the system shall set the status of that invoice to paid.
Given a payment against an invoice being confirmed, When the payment is confirmed, Then the system shall leave the status of the order billed by that invoice unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When an accountant attempts to confirm the payment, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the payment unchanged.
The system shall change the status of an invoice only from issued to paid.

requirements.statement: As a Accountant, I want to reject a pending payment that is invalid, so that the customer can submit an alternative payment against the unsettled invoice.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is pending, When an accountant rejects the payment, Then the system shall set the status of that payment to failed, and shall leave the status of its invoice and of its order unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When an accountant attempts to reject the payment, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the payment unchanged.
The system shall change the status of a payment only from pending to completed or to failed.

requirements.statement: As a OrderStaff, I want to close an order whose status is shipped and whose invoice is paid, so that the fulfilled and paid order is formally completed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is shipped and whose invoice has the status paid, When order staff closes the order, Then the system shall set the status of the order to closed.

Given an order whose status is shipped and whose invoice does not have the status paid, When order staff attempts to close the order, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the order unchanged.

Given an order whose invoice has the status paid but whose order status is not shipped, When order staff attempts to close the order, Then the system shall reject the attempt and leave the status of the order unchanged.
The system shall close a filled order only after both the shipping of the order and the settlement of its invoice have completed, whichever of the two finishes last.
The system shall not change the status of an order whose status is closed.

requirements.statement: When a user submits an order containing up to 50 order items under normal operating conditions, the system shall register the order and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of submissions.
Under normal operating conditions, the system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second while meeting the response time of NFR-01.
The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.
The system shall allow only users holding the accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.
The system shall protect customer personal data and bank account numbers by encrypting them in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest.
The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice and a payment, and shall retain these records for at least 12 months.
The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.
When a server failure occurs, the system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes without losing any order, invoice or payment recorded before the failure.
